about: SONG-NAME: rows for song_name (bench_row song-name). song_name rows expect a call; action/title fields, when present, constrain the expected arguments. N rows expect no song_name call. Discussion rows include prior turns so follow-up intent is measured in context. Persona names only. Rows prefixed heldout- were added after the wording was tuned and were not used for tuning. Rows prefixed heldout2- were added after a second wording round and were not used for tuning. Round 6 (2026-11-14): rows with id prefix heldout3- were written before the playback and question change and are the only rows cited for the pass decision; every earlier row is the frozen dev split. heldout3-home-* rows carry the Home-playing context line and expect NO listen (the answer is already in the context).
